parameters.description: The OpenAI connection ID to use.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The OpenAI model to use.

parameters.name: response_kwargs
parameters.description: Additional keyword arguments to pass to the OpenAI ``create_response`` method (for example ``instructions``, ``tools``, ``conversation`` or ``previous_response_id``).

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: Required. The ID of the batch file to trigger.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Required. The OpenAI Batch API endpoint to trigger.

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: Optional. The OpenAI connection ID to use. Defaults to 'openai_default'.

parameters.name: deferrable
parameters.description: Optional. Run operator in the deferrable mode.

parameters.name: wait_seconds
parameters.description: Optional. Number of seconds between checks. Only used when ``deferrable`` is False. Defaults to 3 seconds.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Optional. The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the request to complete. Only used when ``deferrable`` is False. Defaults to 24 hour, which is the SLA for OpenAI Batch API.

parameters.name: wait_for_completion
parameters.description: Optional. Whether to wait for the batch to complete. If set to False, the operator will return immediately after triggering the batch. Defaults to True.

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`OpenAI connection id <howto/connection:openai>`

parameters.name: conn_id
parameters.description: The OpenAI connection ID to use.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: The ID of the OpenAI batch to wait on.

parameters.name: poll_interval
parameters.description: Seconds between batch status polls.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Deprecated. Absolute wall-clock deadline (``time.time()`` based) after which the trigger reports a timeout. Kept for backward compatibility with triggers that were serialized by the previous version of the operator and are still in flight during an upgrade. Prefer ``timeout`` for new code.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Total seconds to wait for the batch to reach a terminal state before giving up. This is the preferred way to bound the wait because the trigger measures elapsed time with :func:`time.monotonic`, which is not affected by wall-clock jumps (NTP corrections, DST, container clock skew, VM pause/resume). Either ``timeout`` or ``end_time`` must be provided.
